payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sequentially increments sum x+y+k and checks primality via counting non-divisors up to z-1, stopping at the first prime.
payload.rationale: No backtracking, bitmask, branch-and-bound, DFS/BFS, or permutation enumeration occurs; the linear search for the next prime is closest to brute-force trial, and rule_top_subtype offers a weak match.
